title: Union Budget 2026-27
note: All figures in ₹ crore. Actuals are the Controller General of Accounts' unaudited provisional figures for April–September 2026. Budget Estimates are from Budget at a Glance 2026-27.

items.label: Net tax revenue (Centre)
items.note: Gross tax collections grew about 6% year on year. Excise duty fell about 22% after the cut on petrol and diesel; income tax grew about 7%.

items.label: Non-tax revenue
items.note: Front-loaded by the RBI's record ₹2.87 lakh crore surplus transfer in May.

items.label: Revenue expenditure
items.note: Up about 10% year on year, led by subsidies.

items.label: Capital expenditure
items.note: Up about 13% year on year in the first half, but September alone fell about 3%.

extra.label: Major subsidies
extra.note: Urea at about 73% and nutrient-based fertiliser subsidy at about 62% of their budgets by September.
